notes.title: Tormented Souls 2 release date revealed!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, drumroll please… 🥁🥁🥁 


It’s time to prepare yourselves for an entirely new nightmare as Tormented Souls 2 launches on 23rd October 2025!  



To celebrate the rapidly-approaching release of the next instalment in the series we’ve partnered with the Future Games Show at Gamescom 2025 to showcase a pulse-pounding new gameplay trailer, and reveal first details of the monstrous bosses that Caroline will encounter while exploring the hellish ‘Other side’ of Villa Hess.  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/8130011b6809b1f4e03959fedfd11c99c204c303.gif"]



⚠️⚠️WARNING! Spoilers for Tormented Souls ahead! ⚠️⚠️


Check out the ‘A New Nightmare’ Gameplay Trailer as seen in the Future Games Show Gamescom Showcase!

[previewyoutube="2tW08Oy7QmY;full"][/previewyoutube]

In the wake of her sister Anna’s traumatic abduction at the hands of Mother Lucia and her twisted cult, Caroline Walker finds herself trapped deep within the walls of a maze-like convent. With the darkness closing in, Caroline is unexpectedly reacquainted with her old friend, the pneumatic nailer, and so begins a desperate struggle to escape the unholy place. But once free of the convent, the true horror of the secluded Villa Hess reveals itself and Caroline must again call upon her supernatural abilities to travel to the town’s mysterious ‘Other side’ and face the formidable creatures that await within…


Switching realities


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/ce51573734c5757f933c3717242bf470475956ce.gif"]



In the original Tormented Souls it was Caroline’s latent supernatural powers that allowed her to utilise mirrors and video tapes to traverse between alternate realities and timelines to ultimately save Anna from her cruel fate. 


In Tormented Souls 2, Caroline will continue to embrace these powers as she steps into Villa Hess’ mysterious ‘Other side’ and ‘replays’ memories stored on video tapes. Crucially Caroline’s actions in these locations will directly affect the current timeline in Villa Hess, while revealing more about the town’s dark history.


The horrors of the ‘Other side’


Only the foulest and most dangerous creatures reside within the ‘Other side’ and Caroline must be extra vigilant when exploring this twisted new reality. Deadliest of all are beings of immense power that have gorged on the misery and corruption that envelops the region. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/2b84dd25ebd3bb1d8b6f349903891dfc5ee8c85d.jpg"]

Wielding a huge crucifix and protected by a heavy plated mask, the Iron Maiden is a hulking behemoth and cruel disciplinarian who administers punishment amongst the convent’s sisterhood.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/ebae69e4daf50e15406e4fdf7dcfa12b1d879c97.png"]


Meanwhile, deep beneath the stinking halls of the Wildberger & Hess Fish Processing Plant sleeps The Harvester, a terrifying fusion of twisted metal and scorched flesh. Armed with a lethal buzzsaw and gaping maw filled with razor sharp teeth, this subterranean horror seems impervious to all but the heaviest of weapons. 



Until next time!


Dual Effect & PQube

notes.title: 🚨Tormented Souls 2 demo and new look for Caroline incoming!🚨
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s been quite some time since our last post but today we’re finally ready to share some big news regarding Tormented Souls 2 which has been selected to feature in the Latin American Games Showcase taking place on on 7th June @ 11am PT / 7pm BST via Twitch and YouTube.

To celebrate we’ll be releasing a brand new story teaser trailer during the event which introduces several major characters, and shines the spotlight on the mysterious town that Caroline will be exploring over the course of the game. Keep an eye out for several never before seen locations 👀 

On top of this we’ll also be revealing an entirely redesigned look for Caroline which not only reflects feedback we have received since announcement, but also pays tribute to her iconic style from the original Tormented Souls! We can’t wait to share this with you but for now here’s a sneak peak of our brand-new keyart (hot of the press!) featuring a familiar looking silhouette 😉  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/f99bd6f63e96d2530d9b4341efd2914ea4118751.jpg

But that’s not all! We’re proud to announce that our first playable Steam demo will be available to play the day before the showcase on June 6th at approximately 8am PT / 4pm BST 🥳This demo will feature the first 60 minutes of gameplay and will have you navigating the claustrophobic passageways of a sinister convent in search of a gruesome ancient tome…

Lastly, we just wanted to say thank you for your patience and support over the last year. It's been a long road getting to this point, but we’re finally on the home stretch and can’t wait to share more news and information over the coming months as we head towards launch in late 2025 😀

Until next time!

Dual Effect & PQube

notes.title: The Monsters in the Shadows
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/c898e67c405cbc7daecb26b1d58c1fde66d9b612.png

Hey Horror Survival Fans

Wheel Monster:
Old people suffering from dementia and abandoned by their relatives were subjected to horrible experiments. Their eyes were removed and a device planted into their heads to send vibrations directly to their brains to pounce on anything that creates a sound. 

They are extremely fast as they travel in a wheelchair and their extremely long skeletal claws attached to their arms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/0034d95d795756644cf2f6bc84a080658fd7c826.png


Acid Spitter:
This failed experiment may seem less of a threat compared to the others being just a torso and slightly slower, but it can attack from a distance by spitting radioactive acid with its digestive system removed and replaced with a tank of acid. 

It can tear flesh with its claws of surgical steel once at close range.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/b4c57f2091969e5025e879876426fbff756cff2c.png


Wall Monster:
As punishment for leaving their post during a work shift, they were condemned by the mad doctors of the sect to remain eternally attached to a metal piece bolted to a wall. 

Mutilated and tortured, they were armed with large knives so that nothing can ever pass them and they can never leave their post again.

notes.title: The Different POV's of Caroline Walker
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/c898e67c405cbc7daecb26b1d58c1fde66d9b612.png

Want to experience the next generation of classical survival horror controls?

The modern control scheme updates this classic genre for today's players, offering 360° movement and bringing familiarity to players of all levels of experience.

The Dynamic Camera offers fixed-perspective thrills for hardcore fans - but also gives players the ability to adjust camera angles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/517cb23663c95e04dd9b6da2f08d367f9e2d6a74.png

There will be mainly 3 types of cameras:

Rotating camera:

Placed on a specific point and will only follow the player on an angular basis allowing to span wider routes than the static camera. 

This will be the most used type of camera throughout the game giving more control on what’s what wants to be shown for the director.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/e54284adb582111705c317f384634031518c7556.gif

Rail camera:

Following the character through a rail keeping a constant distance. They will be used to span long routes like corridors and will give a cinematographic look to the game. 

Each camera will have a different focal aperture and focus

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/6410979a8f29eea86caf62957f8b9e7f62e7fb96.gif

Static camera: 

Ubicated on a specific place pointing in a unique direction. They won’t move or rotate in any direction, will be used to show places of interest.

notes.title: Fighting against the horrors
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/c898e67c405cbc7daecb26b1d58c1fde66d9b612.png

How do you fight your way through Wildberger Hospital?

Dark forces and unspeakable horrors will do everything in their power to stop Caroline from finding out the truth. Use anything and everything that you can find to fight back the evils that wait in the darkness.

Your range of weapons and usage is essential to your survival. Not only can you use your nailgun to stun from afar but you can also use a crowbar for the final blow and to conserve your ammunition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/026eb894d2031a1d444955134a11c41d468f3b78.gif

Aim:
Sticking to the classic tank controls, Caroline will aim at the closest enemy while using the direction of the axis will change the target.

You can also back-step whilst aiming if the enemy becomes too close and deals a fatal blow to Caroline.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/67f9a112bf2c468f8e90c54a1e4d0c5524b1771a.gif

Shooting:
While aiming at an enemy, using the action button to shoot the current target. This action will
use your ammunition and will lower the stamina level of the damaged enemy.

Use the crowbar to your advantage and deliver the final blow when the enemy is down.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/2ebcd1dcc52dea7fba3ac5d2564970b992529626.gif

Reload:
Caroline’s weapon will have to reload using the reload button so she doesn’t get surprised and with no way of attack. Conserving ammunition is also vital to survival.

Make sure you check your surroundings before you reload, you never know what's hiding in the shadows.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/e6ebb4ada3e7440911d10e0a4de011a0ce99c933.gif

We're excited to announce Tormented Souls will be taking part in this year's Next Fest!

Want to know more before you play the demo? Read below to experience the mystery that is Tormented Souls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/d55ce8512e5521bad1813c269c0c5410a77496ee.png

Who is Caroline Walker?

Caroline Walker, an average and very normal elementary school teacher, received a strange letter containing a strange polaroid picture of two twin girls.

While investigating the disappearance of two twin girls at the decrepit mansion at Winterlake-something terrible happens to Caroline Walker... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/13e68bed6066c4f7fa79117467fe4872dc3756f0.gif

Ever since she looked at the photo, all she could see was them looking right back at her every time her eyes closed. From that moment on, nothing was the same. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/d4a8c8d8fd096c7e6b821e01093f5e417caf7506.png

What's inside Winterlake Mansion?

After receiving the letter and experiencing a week of strange symptoms she knew she couldn't continue with her normal life. She started to feel anxious during the day and having horrible nightmares. That's when she realized she had no choice but to visit the mansion. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/2f12102ccbf8ba5ae84fa05288010d5574fa93b6.gif

Will you help her escape?

Upon entering the hospital converted mansion, the quiet and eerie atmosphere surrounded her, and before she could investigate further she is knocked over by a mysterious stranger. Confused and alone, Caroline wakes up in a bathtub connected to breathing machines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/74bf5ebbccf0a23e16f649a63c87783283a1a8e0.gif

notes.title: We're Delighted to Announce Tormented Souls - A Brand New Survival Horror
notes.content:
SOMETHING EVIL LURKS AT WINTERLAKE

We're delighted to announce Tormented Souls - A Brand New Survival Horror Game

Tormented Souls is an indie passion project and the realisation of a dream for twin brothers Gabriel and German Araneda. Fuelled only by the love of the medium and without any previous knowledge of making video games, they developed Tormented Souls by taking inspiration from classic survival horror titles like Resident Evil and Silent Hill.
 
We're thrilled to be bringing Tormented Souls to Steam and consoles in 2021. With it's gorgeous visuals and fresh take on the genre for a new generation, we think you'll be as hooked on the story of Caroline Walker and her investigation into the mysterious events at Winterlake as we are.
